libsndfile 1.2.2 (https://libsndfile.github.io/libsndfile/, LGPL-2.1, see COPYING), unmodified: the 64-bit Windows
build shipped in the Python "soundfile" package (_soundfile_data/libsndfile_x64.dll). The launcher loads it at run
time for Tempest 3000's disc compression (Vorbis encoding); it is not linked into any program.
